استلهمت (form X)
# اِسْتَلْهَمْتُ (istalhamtu) /is.tal.ham.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اِسْتَلْهَمْتَ (istalhamta) /is.tal.ham.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اِسْتَلْهَمْتِ (istalhamti) /is.tal.ham.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اِسْتَلْهَمَتْ (istalhamat) /is.t
